title: The Heating Effect of Current
summary: Current heats wires. Nichrome heaters, irons and geysers, and how fuses and MCBs protect our homes.

ib.note: Power P = VI and energy calculations are MYP 5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 4: Electricity: Magnetic and Heating Effects

objectives: I can explain that an electric current heats the wire it flows through.
I can explain why heating elements use nichrome and why a fuse protects a circuit.
I can calculate current from power (I = P ÷ V) and energy used in units (kWh).
misconceptions: Only heaters get hot when current flows.
A fuse makes appliances work better.
Using a thicker wire as a fuse is safer.
